name: Canal Ring
source: 3D BAG (tudelft3d + 3DGI), v20250903, BAG footprints; heights from the AHN point clouds (AHN5 © Het Waterschapshuis, CC BY 4.0; AHN4 and AHN3, CC0), CC BY 4.0
heightSource: 3D BAG LoD1.2 roof 70th percentile minus ground level (NAP)
heightNote: Height = 70th-percentile roof elevation minus ground level, both NAP metres (3D BAG v20250903: lod12_2d b3_h_70p minus pand b3_h_maaiveld; ground is the 5th percentile of AHN ground points within 4 m of the building). A building cut into parts is emitted one row per part. Footprints: BAG polygons, exterior ring only, simplified to 0.5 m in the local frame, rings under 4.0 m2 dropped, clipped by centroid. Null heights or b3_pw_onvoldoende take the shared 2.5 m fill (hSource 'fill'). RD New to WGS84 via pyproj operation 'Inverse of RD New + Amersfoort to WGS 84 (4) (with axis order normalized for visualization)' (stated accuracy 1 m). © 3DBAG by tudelft3d and 3DGI (CC BY 4.0); modified as stated. GROUND PLAUSIBILITY: for 51 building(s) 3D BAG's ground was more than 3 m below the median of the 5+ buildings within 75 m (or, with fewer neighbours, a building older than the AHN4 survey whose AHN4 height agrees); their ground is the 5th percentile of the AHN4 DTM ring around the footprint (hSource '3dbag-p70-ahn4-ground'). Never raises a height; never leaves a part under 2 m; never applied to buildings from 2020 on.
crossCheck: AHN4 nDSM p70 (guard G5): hCheck on 21072 of 21342 buildings, 190 flagged where |h - hCheck| > 5 m; hCheck is never blended into h
